{{Short description|Mathematical project}}
{{Notability|Organization|date=February 2025}}
The '''Atlas of Lie Groups and Representations''' is a [[mathematics|mathematical]] project to solve the [[unitary representation|problem of the unitary dual]] for real  [[reductive group|reductive]] [[Lie group]]s.<ref>{{cite conference |last1=Noël |first1=Alfred G. |title=A General Computational Scheme for Testing Admissibility of Nilpotent Orbits of Real Lie Groups of Inner Type |conference=Mathematical Software - ICMS 2006 |date=2006 |page=10 |doi=10.1007/11832225_1 |url=https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/11832225_1 |publisher=Springer |language=en|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{cite conference |last1=Adams |first1=Jeffrey |last2=Saunders |first2=B. David |last3=Wan |first3=Zhendong |title=Signature of symmetric rational matrices and the unitary dual of lie groups |conference=ISSAC '05: Proceedings of the 2005 international symposium on Symbolic and algebraic computation |date=24 July 2005 |pages=14 |doi=10.1145/1073884.1073889}}</ref>
